These are the technical details for `SSN2` regarding the construction of covariance matrices involving hydrologic distances. Technical details that are based only on the covariance matrix (e.g., model-fitting and prediction) are available in [`spmodel`'s technical documentation](https://usepa.github.io/spmodel/articles/technical.html); @dumelle2023spmodel.
